jobs.description:

Bachelors degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
Experience
3+ years of experience in financial planning, data analytics, or business intelligence roles.

Required Certifications
SAC Certification such as SAP Certified Associate - Data Analyst for SAP Analytics Cloud

Planning and Forecasting:
Design, develop, and maintain planning models in SAP Analytics Cloud to support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities.

Integrate SAC with other SAP and non-SAP systems for seamless data flows, using Data Integration and Wrangling techniques.

Address user queries and troubleshoot any issues related to SAP SAC planning, reporting, and visualization features.
Act as a point of contact for SAC-related technical issues and liaise with SAP support when needed.
